name: graph-beta
description: Beta line of the graph plugin. Same engine as graph 1.7.0 plus kinds (code / document), flows with develop/document entry skills, and a second MCP server, task-manager, that splits medium and large requests into packages, runs each as its own graph in its own worktree, integrates and reports. Runs are kept under .harness-run/broker-beta/ and ~/.harness/tasks/ so it never touches a stable graph run. Do not enable graph and graph-beta in the same project. Zero runtime dependencies beyond Node 18+.
